method: Vector art in native texel coordinates, drawn at 4x (4x4 samples per texel, exact integer arithmetic) and averaged onto the existing native pixels; existing palette plus spare slots, the mud twin's own rule, fixed spans. Runs after the uf1 and uf2 layers.
